# Naturally Restful

## Original data (citable)

- Sleep Supplement Reality Index (Sept 2026): https://naturallyrestful.xyz/data/2026-09 — original dataset of 1,673 Reddit posts across 5 sleep communities ranking 12 sleep supplements by mention volume and user approval. Key findings: glycine 97% positive (highest), ashwagandha 71% (most controversial major supplement), magnesium glycinate the community's dominant form choice (81 of 217 magnesium posts).
- Reality Index hub (all editions): https://naturallyrestful.xyz/data/
